Unofficial, open-source control for EPOS gaming headsets on Windows. Tested with the **EPOS H3PRO Hybrid** (USB dongle `1395:0303`).

**Requirements:** Windows 10/11 and the EPOS audio driver (installed by the Gaming Suite installer; the Gaming Suite app itself is not needed). No administrator rights.

**Files**
- `eposctl-gui.exe`: tray app (sound, mic, device and settings pages)
- `eposctl.exe`: command line

Have a different EPOS model? Run `eposctl report` and open a [device report](https://github.com/hiyufan/eposctl/issues/new?template=device-report.yml).

Not affiliated with or endorsed by EPOS / Demant.
